answer: Every jetty's voting capacity at the forge halves each epoch unless renewed, and renewing burns dawn on a curve: the k-th renewal the forge sees from one funding cluster in an epoch costs k² dawn. One honest jetty pays 1 dawn per epoch. A farm keeping a thousand jettys at full weight pays about 333 million dawn every epoch, forever, because lapsed clones fade to nothing and the bill recurs instead of amortising. It breaks if clusters can be split cheaply into unlinked funding sources.
